name: Amazon Selling Partner
description: Ecommerce: Amazon's Selling Partner API (SP-API) for sellers/vendors covering orders, listings, feeds, reports, fulfillment, pricing and notifications.
access_notes: Developers must submit a developer profile (Solution Provider Portal or Seller Central) that Amazon reviews and approves before API access; restricted roles (PII) trigger a more rigorous audit. Public apps then use Login with Amazon OAuth per selling partner; private apps can self-authorize. A sandbox exists but production access is gated on the registration review.
mcp_notes: Amazon ships an official local MCP package @amazon-sp-api-release/sp-api-dev-mcp (dev-assistant + workflow servers) in the amzn/selling-partner-api-samples repo. No SP-API-specific Composio toolkit found (composio.dev/toolkits/amazon-selling-partner and /amazon_selling_partner return 404; Composio's generic 'amazon' toolkit is not SP-API).
uncertainty_notes: supports_webhooks refers to the SP-API Notifications API, which pushes events to Amazon SQS/EventBridge destinations rather than arbitrary HTTPS endpoints. Grantless operations use an LWA client_credentials-style grant.

evidence.note: Developer profile form with security-controls questions; Amazon reviews and approves/denies registration, with extra audit for restricted (PII) roles
Public apps must use Login with Amazon (Amazon's OAuth 2.0) authorization-code flow; refresh tokens exchanged for access tokens at runtime
Sandbox available for exploration; production requires full LWA OAuth authorization; private apps can self-authorize (max 10 authorizations)
Official Amazon npm package bundling sp-api-dev-assistant and sp-api-workflow MCP servers, including live sp_api_execute tool
